description: A shell script that initializes and seeds a PostgreSQL database. It creates extensions, tables, indexes, and inserts an initial admin user with configurable parameters.
calls: psql -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT}" -U "${DB_USER}" -d "${DB_NAME}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"uuid-ossp\";"
psql -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT}" -U "${DB_USER}" -d "${DB_NAME}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (...)"
psql -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT}" -U "${DB_USER}" -d "${DB_NAME}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assets (...)"
psql -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT}" -U "${DB_USER}" -d "${DB_NAME}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS allocations (...)"
psql -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT}" -U "${DB_USER}" -d "${DB_NAME}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audits (...)"
psql -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT}" -U "${DB_USER}" -d "${DB_NAME}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ..."
